locations.name: Materials Yard
locations.apprentice: Gain 3 resources in any combination of Clay and Wood.
locations.shifu: Gain 4 resources in any combination of Clay and Wood.

locations.name: Forming Studio
locations.apprentice: Pay the normal Clay cost to shape 1 vessel of any Shape.
locations.shifu: Pay the normal Clay costs to shape up to 2 vessels of any Shapes.

locations.name: Glaze Workshop
locations.apprentice: Apply 1 Glaze and choose 1 Decoration for 1 shaped ceramic. Pay the Decoration cost normally.
locations.shifu: Choose one: apply Glaze and Decoration to up to 2 shaped ceramics, paying costs normally; or apply Glaze and Decoration to 1 shaped ceramic and ignore that Decoration's Coin cost.

locations.name: Kiln Yard
locations.apprentice: Load 1 glazed ceramic into any empty kiln space.
locations.shifu: Load up to 2 glazed ceramics into any empty kiln spaces.
clarifications: At least 1 eligible ceramic must be loaded.
The Shifu does not reposition ceramics.

locations.name: Market & Imperial Office
locations.apprentice: Choose one: take 1 face-up or blind-top Market or Imperial Order; or gain 2 Coins. After a normal main action, you may sell 1 Flawed ceramic for 1 Coin.
locations.shifu: Choose one: take up to 2 face-up or blind-top Orders; take 1 Order and gain 2 Coins; gain 4 Coins; or use eligible Court Patronage. After a normal main action, you may sell up to 2 Flawed ceramics for 1 Coin each.
locations.clarification: Court Patronage requires a completed Imperial Order, costs 5 Coins, advances Progress by 1 only from spaces 0-3, and grants neither Colour Samples nor a Flawed sale.

locations.name: Guild & Academy
locations.apprentice: Pay the printed Coin cost and acquire 1 face-up Technique.
locations.shifu: Before choosing, you may place 1 face-up Technique on the bottom of its discipline deck and reveal a replacement. Then acquire 1 face-up Technique for 1 Coin less than its printed cost, minimum 1 Coin.
